contato.texto: Good ideas start with encounters, exchanges and curiosity.

paragrafos: More than a professional path, the following projects show how my way of thinking, leading and turning strategy into business results has evolved.

blocos.texto: Strategic direction at Blast to communicate credit to women micro-entrepreneurs, with qualitative research, a survey and a WhatsApp focus group to generate insights for the creative team.
Curation of news, trends and industry movements.
Desk research and social listening on Mexican men's relationship with bathing, leading to the opportunity: Old Spice turns any ordinary shower into a legendary one.
Benchmark for curating agribusiness influencers and opinion leaders, in partnership with W+K Argentina, for a brand event.
I took part in the pitch with mystery shopping: I visited stores, observed touchpoints and talked to staff to map what sets the in-store experience apart.

paragrafos: Before working in strategy, I built my career in audiovisual and event production. That's where I developed my eye for the big picture and the ability to connect people, organize processes and turn ideas into deliverables.

blocos.texto: I directed production of the festival's audiovisual coverage in Rio de Janeiro, with a local crew, real-time deliveries and an aftermovie.

blocos.titulo: Open Bar de Beijo — Banda Eva
blocos.texto: On-the-ground production at Salvador's Carnival, leading the field operation and real-time logistics.
Production support for the director of photography during three days of shooting in Itapuã, aligning direction, camera and set.

texto: To refresh Rádio Bahia FM's “Tô Ligado” music video, I worked as co-writer and production director, combining my creative expertise with process management.

In pre-production, I led the research, the briefing and the scriptwriting. During the shoot, my 360º view of planning and logistics kept the project running efficiently, coordinating crews and suppliers to bring the script to life.
The result was a complete and successful project, showing my skills in strategic planning, management and end-to-end coordination.

blocos.texto: I led production of the audiovisual coverage of the festival's first edition in Salvador, with a local crew, real-time deliveries and an aftermovie.
Co-leadership and communication strategy, connecting teams and logistics across several simultaneous venues.
Set production over three shooting days of the school's institutional campaign, supporting the organization of each day and real-time needs.
